title: SourceMetadata
description: Where a record came from, under which licence, and when it was retrieved. Retrieval metadata is captured at retrieval time; it cannot be reconstructed afterwards.

source.description: e.g. px4_flight_review, uav_sead, era5, copernicus_dem, metar

source_version.description: Dataset or product ID and version as reported by the source.

source_record_id.description: Identifier of the record at the source, for attribution and re-retrieval.

licence.description: SPDX identifier where one exists, otherwise the licence name as published by the source.

attribution.description: Attribution string required by the source, carried into every derived artifact.

content_hash.description: Hash of the retrieved bytes, algorithm-prefixed (e.g. sha256:...).
